The limit polynomial

The perturbations are summable: \|P_m-P_k\|\le 2\alpha_k/(1-a), so (P_k) converges to a symmetric form Q with \|Q-P_k\|\le4\alpha_k (eq:tailQ).

The limit Q of the sequence P_k.

def limQ [CompleteSpace Y] (A : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1)) (a : ℝ) : MLin 𝕜 X Y (d + 1) := limUnder atTop (seqP A a)
lemma tendsto_limQ [CompleteSpace Y] [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A) (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) : Tendsto (seqP A a) atTop (𝓝 (limQ A a)) := (cauchySeq_seqP hA hA1 ha ha8).tendsto_limUnderlemma isSymm_limQ [CompleteSpace Y] [Nontrivial X] (hA : IsSymm A) (hA1 : polyNorm (diag A) = 1) (ha : 0 < a) (ha8 : a < 1 / 8) : IsSymm (limQ A a) := isClosed_isSymm.mem_of_tendsto (tendsto_limQ hA hA1 ha ha8) (Eventually.of_forall fun k => isSymm_seqP hA k)
